title: Nscale marks launch of first servers with Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72 system
summary: Nscale deploys world's first server cluster powered by Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 architecture
detailed: UK-based Nscale launched its first data centre servers powered by Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72 system for rack-scale AI supercomputing.
The deployment utilizes NVL72 systems embedded with Dell PowerEdge XE9812 servers.
Nscale anticipates a global rollout with additional server deployments in the coming months.
sentences: UK-based Nscale has switched on its first data centre servers powered by Nvidia's latest computing hardware for rack-scale AI supercomputing, the Vera Rubin NVL72.
Nscale is deploying NVL72 systems embedded with Dell's PowerEdge XE9812 servers.
While the firm did not specify which of its AI factories are getting NVL72 servers, it anticipates a global rollout with additional deployments in the coming months.
